workload.initial: 50% synthetic signed-in accounts / 50% guests (rounded by fixed 10-actor blocks); 80% Daily across mixed, powered-cube and latest, 20% entitled practice with rerolls; eight paced view/pick pairs, score/share/eligibility checks, boards and account-attachment cohort
workload.hold: All original actors remain present. Guest cohort polls Daily status and representative boards every 15 seconds; originally signed-in accounts repeatedly play eight-pick entitled practice, rotating mixed, cube, single-set and multi-set custom; every practice run rerolls. No repeated identity creation or quota reset.
workload.recovery: After draining mutations, five existing actors (one per real egress) read status and boards for 60 seconds. No new accounts, mutation replay or provider calls.
workload.limits: Finite mixed-lifecycle closed-loop sessions on five networks, not 100 continuously in-flight requests, geographic diversity or indefinite endurance. Gateway sampling cannot prove lossless telemetry. Client bytes are decoded response bytes, not provider egress. Project billing-counter deltas include all branches and have no settlement watermark; they are a conservative stop signal, never run-attributed usage. Cost ceilings are resource envelopes, not a dollar invoice.
workload.live_abort: Per-runner rolling route p95/p99 over up to 200 samples is checked after 25 samples, in addition to complete-stage/phase gates. The first application error, correctness failure or local resource exhaustion stops the cohort.
